subject: Request: Additional trial credits & short extension for Greystone head-to-head evaluation
messages:
From: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@greystone.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Heads up — need a bit more runway for our bakeoff evaluation

Hi Soojin,

Quick note from the Greystone side — we received the updated scoring rubric and timeline for the RFP bakeoff (vendor demos next week, final evaluation 12/20). Our infra team ran into token consumption higher than expected during the end-to-end tests and we are behind in the feature parity tests we promised the stakeholders.

We like Redwood’s latency/cost profile and want to include you in the final head-to-head, but we need two things to proceed confidently:

- A modest bump to the evaluation allocation (additional trial credits) so we can finish the full runner of our test set (roughly 25k–40k tokens more).
- A short trial extension of 10 days (to cover the re-run and final scoring) — current trial window ends 12/10.

I attached our evaluation matrix and a short note on the test cases we’ll re-run (greystone_eval_matrix.xlsx). Can Redwood provide a firm number and any conditional terms?

If helpful, we’re happy to jump on a 20–30 min sync this afternoon.

Thanks,
Tom Rivers
Senior Product Manager
Greystone Analytics

---
Attachment: greystone_eval_matrix.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@greystone.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Dec 2028 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Heads up — need a bit more runway for our bakeoff evaluation

Tom — thanks for the detail and for sending the matrix. Glad to hear you’re still planning to include Redwood in the final comparison.

We can typically grant supplemental credits for bakeoffs like this; I’ll kick this to sales ops for a quick approval. Two quick asks to speed approval:

1) Can you confirm the expected token bump range (25k–40k is fine, we just need a target).
2) Will the tests use shared (anonymized) customer data or strictly synthetic/test data? (data type affects any additional compliance controls).

I’m tentatively proposing a 25,000 token top-up + a 10-day extension to your trial window as a provisional offer, pending ops sign-off and a short usage commitment (we ask teams to share final test logs so we can correlate cost). If that’s reasonable, I’ll route the formal approval now and loop in legal if required.

If you’re free at 3pm PT I can jump on a quick demo walkthrough to confirm endpoints and KV caching settings that will reduce consumption.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Dec 2028 13:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Heads up — need a bit more runway for our bakeoff evaluation

Team — routing an approval request for Greystone Analytics. Context: A high-prob RFP bakeoff (multiple vendors) with an evaluation deadline 2028-12-20. AE (Soojin) proposes a provisional top-up of 25k tokens and a 10-day trial extension to cover re-runs. Greystone supplied a test matrix (attached).

Recommendation: Approve a one-time 30,000 token evaluation credit and extend the trial window to 2028-12-20 (to align with their scoring deadline). Conditions:
- Credits are time-limited and expire 2028-12-20 23:59 PT.
- Credits applied only to the account used for the evaluation (no cross-account transfers).
- Greystone must accept the attached evaluation credit terms (approval_form_greystone.pdf) and confirm tests use synthetic or anonymized data; otherwise legal review is required.

Rationale: The deal shows signs of movement into POC + potential pilot spend; small incremental investment likely to preserve Redwood in the shortlist.

Attaching the approval form for signatures. Please confirm and I’ll dispatch the credit grant.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
---
Attachment: approval_form_greystone.pdf (pdf)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Dec 2028 15:50:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Heads up — need a bit more runway for our bakeoff evaluation

Marissa — +1 on the 30k credit approval with the proposed conditions. A few operational notes before we commit:

- Add a clause that credits are revoked if the account spikes usage beyond the documented test matrix without prior notice.
- Require Greystone to enable SSO + standard SOC2 access controls for the evaluation account (we can relax if they insist, but it’s preferred).
- We should prepare a short set of recommended runtime settings (batching/cache) and offer an onboarding hour with infra to minimize re-run consumption.

I’ve drafted a short terms addendum (credit_terms_draft.docx) — please incorporate into the approval form and I’ll sign off.

If all agree, Soojin, go ahead and confirm to Greystone that we’ll provision 30k tokens expiring 2028-12-20 23:59 PT and send the updated terms.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com
---
Attachment: credit_terms_draft.docx (docx)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Rivers <tom.rivers@greystone.ai>, Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@greystone.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Dec 2028 17:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Heads up — need a bit more runway for our bakeoff evaluation

Tom / Aisha — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per our internal approvals we can provision the following:

- 30,000 trial credits (one-time allocation) applied to the evaluation account you supplied.
- Trial window extended to 2028-12-20 23:59 PT; unused credits will expire at that time.
- Conditional terms: credits will be revoked if usage materially exceeds the documented test matrix; SSO + SOC2 controls preferred; acceptance of the attached summary required for provisioning.

Attached: greystone_terms_summary.pdf (summary of applied conditions and endpoints). Please reply to this thread accepting the conditions and confirm whether the tests will use anonymized or synthetic data. Once we have that confirmation I’ll trigger the credit grant and share the updated account activity dashboard link.

If you want the onboarding hour with our infra team before re-running the suite we can schedule tomorrow morning PT.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
